params.body:
Small correction to the bookkeeping, found while looking at how the issue list is moving.

The finding about "48.500 km written back as 48,5" says `opgelost_in: #661`. That pull request was
replaced (it was behind main) and it was **#663** that merged. So the `Fixes #612` never fired and
issue #612 has been sitting open for four days with its fix already in production.

The number is corrected. #612 can be closed by hand, or the next mirror run will report it as a
resolved finding whose issue is still open, which is exactly what that report is for.

This is the one thing the mirror cannot do by itself: it writes the issue number into the file, but
the pull request number goes in by hand, and a re-proposed pull request gets a new one.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: The 48.500 finding points at the pull request that fixed it
